# dendromatic

Processing, cleaning and normalization of point-dendrometer time series.
The computational core behind the DendroMatic Shiny applications, usable
standalone in scripted workflows.

**Status: pre-release (0.1.x).** GitHub/r-universe stage; CRAN
submission is planned only after the API freezes at 1.0.0. Function
names may still change â€” pin a commit/tag if you depend on this.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("treenet/treenetproc")   # suggested dependency
remotes::install_github("lealzito/dendromatic")
```

## Core pipeline

``` r

library(dendromatic)

L0 <- dm_build_l0(raw_df, ts_col = "timestamp", value_col = "um",
                  site = "MYSITE", tz_in = "Etc/GMT-1")
L1 <- dm_proc_l1(L0, vars = "value", reso = 10)
cleaned <- dm_clean_series(L1, brks = list(MYSITE_FaSy001 = list(
  c("2021-06-01 00:00:00", "2021-06-04 12:00:00"))))
```

The cleaning core is also available as composable steps:

``` r

L1 |>
  dm_level_breaks(brks)  |>   # growth-aware sensor-break leveling
  dm_erase_dormancy()    |>   # NA outside the growing season
  dm_align_seasons()     |>   # carry growth across winters
  dm_rebase_zero()            # floor each series at zero
```

Try it on the shipped synthetic dataset `dendro_sample`; see
[`vignette("dendromatic")`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/articles/dendromatic.md)
(quick start) and
[`vignette("break-leveling")`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/articles/break-leveling.md)
(method). Progress reporting works in terminals and Shiny alike via
[`progressr::with_progress()`](https://progressr.futureverse.org/reference/with_progress.html).

Every function also answers to its original DendroMatic name
([`raw_to_L0()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_l0.md),
[`multi_proc_L1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_proc_l1.md),
[`apply_breaks_and_shift()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_clean_series.md),
…).

## API map

| `dm_*` name | original name | purpose |
|----|----|----|
| [`dm_build_l0()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_l0.md) | [`raw_to_L0()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_l0.md) | any raw logger table -\> treenetproc L0 |
| [`dm_proc_l1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_proc_l1.md) | [`multi_proc_L1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_proc_l1.md) | per-variable proc_L1 + join |
| [`dm_run_pipeline()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_run_pipeline.md) | [`run_L1_L2()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_run_pipeline.md) | L0 -\> L1 -\> L2 backbone with RDS outputs |
| [`dm_clean_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_clean_series.md) | [`apply_breaks_and_shift()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_clean_series.md) | breaks + dormancy + alignment + zero-norm |
| [`dm_level_breaks()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_level_breaks.md) | â€” (new, 0.2.0) | break leveling step alone |
| [`dm_erase_dormancy()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_erase_dormancy.md) | â€” (new, 0.2.0) | dormancy erasure step alone |
| [`dm_align_seasons()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_align_seasons.md) | â€” (new, 0.2.0) | season alignment step alone |
| [`dm_rebase_zero()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_rebase_zero.md) | â€” (new, 0.2.0) | per-series zero re-base step alone |
| [`dm_merge_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_merge_series.md) | [`merge_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_merge_series.md) | merge consecutive series, same tree |
| [`dm_pdmd_extrema()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_pdmd_extrema.md) | [`compute_pdmd_extrema_tz()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_pdmd_extrema.md) | daily predawn/midday TWD extrema |
| [`dm_build_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_sfw.md) | [`build_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_sfw.md) | assemble SFW table from L2 + phase stats |
| [`dm_match_lwp()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_match_lwp.md) | [`match_lwp_to_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_match_lwp.md) | two-tier LWP campaign matching |
| [`dm_build_temp_l1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_temp_l1.md) | [`build_temp_L1_generic()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_temp_l1.md) | assemble temperature L1 from a folder |
| [`dm_read_table()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_read_table.md) | [`read_any_table()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_read_table.md) | delimiter/encoding-robust table reader |
| [`dm_repair_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_repair_series.md) | [`repair_series_HOLstyle()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_repair_series.md) | standardize series IDs (SITE_SpAb###) |
| [`dm_species_lut()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_species_lut.md) | [`default_species_lut()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_species_lut.md) | species abbreviation lookup table |

# Package index

## Cleaning pipeline

The DendroMatic cleaning core and its composable steps.

- [`dm_clean_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_clean_series.md)
  [`apply_breaks_and_shift()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_clean_series.md)
  : Clean a dendrometer series: breaks, dormancy, alignment, zero base
- [`dm_level_breaks()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_level_breaks.md)
  : Level sensor breaks with growth-aware shifting
- [`dm_erase_dormancy()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_erase_dormancy.md)
  : Erase dormancy periods outside the growing season
- [`dm_align_seasons()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_align_seasons.md)
  : Align each season's start to the prior year's maximum
- [`dm_rebase_zero()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_rebase_zero.md)
  : Re-base each series so its minimum is zero

## Ingestion and processing

- [`raw_to_L0()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_l0.md)
  [`dm_build_l0()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_l0.md)
  : Convert a raw dendrometer table to 'treenetproc' L0 format
- [`multi_proc_L1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_proc_l1.md)
  [`dm_proc_l1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_proc_l1.md)
  : Run 'treenetproc' L1 processing per variable
- [`run_L1_L2()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_run_pipeline.md)
  [`dm_run_pipeline()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_run_pipeline.md)
  : Run the L0 to L1 to L2 site pipeline backbone
- [`merge_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_merge_series.md)
  [`dm_merge_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_merge_series.md)
  : Merge consecutive dendrometer series from the same tree
- [`build_temp_L1_generic()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_temp_l1.md)
  [`dm_build_temp_l1()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_temp_l1.md)
  : Assemble a temperature L1 object from a climate folder

## Water-relations outputs

- [`compute_pdmd_extrema_tz()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_pdmd_extrema.md)
  [`dm_pdmd_extrema()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_pdmd_extrema.md)
  : Daily predawn and midday tree water deficit extrema (local time)
- [`build_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_sfw.md)
  [`dm_build_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_build_sfw.md)
  : Assemble the standard SFW table from daily L2 and phase statistics
- [`match_lwp_to_sfw()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_match_lwp.md)
  [`dm_match_lwp()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_match_lwp.md)
  : Match leaf water potential campaigns to the SFW table

## Utilities and data

- [`read_any_table()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_read_table.md)
  [`dm_read_table()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_read_table.md)
  : Read a delimited text file or Excel workbook
- [`repair_series_HOLstyle()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_repair_series.md)
  [`dm_repair_series()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_repair_series.md)
  : Standardise series identifiers to SITE_SpAb### style
- [`default_species_lut()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_species_lut.md)
  [`dm_species_lut()`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dm_species_lut.md)
  : Default species abbreviation lookup table
- [`dendro_sample`](https://lealzito.github.io/dendromatic/reference/dendro_sample.md)
  : Synthetic example dendrometer dataset
